# Giant Ancestry: Stone's Endurance (`traits:giant-ancestry-stones-endurance`)
**Species:** [Goliath](../species/goliath.md) | **Subspecies:** [Giant Ancestry: Stone's Endurance](../subspecies/giant-ancestry-stones-endurance.md)

When you take damage, you can take a Reaction to roll 1d12. Add your Constitution modifier to the number rolled and reduce the damage by that total.
